gold: Glioblastoma (World Health Organization grade IV) with optic nerve invasion and intraocular extension

selector.rationale: The presence of mutant IDH-1 protein and loss of ATRX protein, along with the astrocytic neoplasm features, supports IDH-mutant Astrocytoma as the most specific diagnosis

rejected.label: Central Retinal Artery Occlusion
rejected.why: Although there is evidence of central retinal artery occlusion, it is a secondary finding related to the primary neoplastic process

rejected.label: Glioblastoma
rejected.why: The Ki-67 proliferation index is ~10%, which is lower than typically seen in glioblastoma

rejected.label: Astrocytic Neoplasm
rejected.why: While astrocytic neoplasm is a broad category that includes IDH-mutant Astrocytoma, the latter is a more specific diagnosis supported by the molecular features
